document.description: The ISO14064-3 Claim Evidence Schema defines the structure for submitting claims of carbon credit issuance and ecosystem benefits tied to a specific site and project. This schema focuses on evidence-based outcomes, including net ecosystem exchange, vintage, and verification details, ensuring transparency and compliance with ISO14064-3 standards.

document.title: ISO14064-3 Site Registration Standard
document.description: The ISO14064-3 Site Registration Standard defines the schema for registering individual sites or installations within a larger project. It captures essential geographic, ecological, and carbon monitoring details, ensuring traceability and compliance with ISO14064-3 standards. This schema serves as a foundation for future claims tied to specific areas within the project.
